intro: Your living room’s quiet anchor. The Herb coffee table in walnut blends warm tones with simple design, making every tea break, chat, or late-night movie feel grounded, cozy, and easy to share.

features.title: Walnut finish that warms your space
features.text: Rich walnut tones add depth and elegance, creating a backdrop that makes your décor and daily rituals feel timeless and inviting.

features.title: Compact design for flexible layouts
features.text: Sized to fit neatly in front of your sofa, it adapts to small or large living rooms, leaving enough space for free movement while staying useful.

features.title: Easy-to-clean surface for daily use
features.text: Smooth finish makes wiping spills and dust effortless, so your living space stays fresh and ready for family or guests at all times.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
